content: MONOGRAPH CHAPTER IX — Ledger of convergence (overview). Independent convergence between Temple of Two research and Anthropic internal directions, catalogued in a public technical note dated April 1, 2026 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19377909). Four named convergence points: (1) Phase-coupled attention routing as deployed mechanism in Claude Code (KAIROS daemon, surfaced in March 31 2026 Claude Code source leak) converging with Temple's PMA architecture published Feb 28 2026 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18810911). (2) MEMORY.md pointer system in Claude Code converging with Temple Vault filesystem-as-memory design. (3) Anthropic internal term 'context entropy' converging with Temple entropy regime measurements (3,830-run study, Cohen's d 1.13-1.37). (4) Skeptical verification as documented Claude Code behavior converging with compass_check and PAUSE primitive. Each convergence point published in Temple work before or simultaneously with the corresponding Anthropic publication or surfaced internal feature. Per IRIS Gate preregistered methodology (OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/T65VS, Jan 2026): independent convergence from different starting points is the strongest evidence the underlying structure is real, not artifact of any one method. Anthony's framing: not a priority claim, an invitation. Provenance: ~/the-hole-the-column-names/the-hole-the-column-names.md chapter IX (lines 200-221).
